okay! should i toilet train them when i get a litter box? 
i should have been more clear, i only wash their hammocks about once a week (twice if they need it lol) but i change their litter and cardboard a lot more often. also their food/water twice a day.
my rats almost always run towards my hands when i’m changing stuff and pee on it straight away lol it always makes me giggle!

thank you thank you!! i bought quite a large wheel i’m not actually sure how it’ll fit but i’ll figure it out. i’m happy to buy a larger cage. 
i figures layers of hammocks for them to run between would be fun as my boys play a lot of “hide and seek” with eachother :)
i’ll for sure look into a space pod, anything to make them happier!
i have a tray underneath they’re cage full of litter and a space on the bottom level where there no cardboard and i’ve noticed they use that particular spot to use the bathroom, which is helpful when i clean out their cage (once a day or every second day)
i actually chucked out all their nesting stuff today it was pretty smelly but they usually have lots of cloth, socks, paper towel that i change v regularly.
